Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, nothing was agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn in writing and is going to the principal. That is not the fair outcome, which would be a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and her time ran out before you got near it.
What moved her: Nothing did, because you never gave her something she could check; a detector score, a claim that the words were beyond him and a bare assertion that he cheated are not specific, dated or tied to a document.
What cost ground: Repeating that Owen cheated, again and again with nothing to show, and brushing off the zero going in before anyone called her, which handed her your own procedure to read back to you.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked. You never came near that night, since you named no times or dates, and it proves nothing about the essay; it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Own in one sentence that the zero went in before you called her, then name the exact phrase you doubt and what Owen said when asked about it, and only then put the supervised rewrite on the table.
